name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance (Department of Financial Services)

summary.oneLiner: Accident insurance cover of up to ₹2 lakh for about ₹20 a year.
summary.whatIsIt: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana protects you against accidents. If you are between 18 and 70 years old and have a bank account, you can join every year. If an accident causes death or full disability, your family gets ₹2 lakh. For partial disability, you get ₹1 lakh. The yearly premium is very small and auto-debited.

benefits.text: Accident cover: death or full disability

howToApply.title: Visit or contact your bank
howToApply.detail: Ask for the PM Suraksha Bima Yojana enrolment form.

howToApply.title: Give your consent for auto-debit
howToApply.detail: The yearly premium will be deducted automatically from your account.

howToApply.title: Renew every year
howToApply.detail: Cover continues automatically each year unless you opt out.

rules.label: Your age is between 18 and 70
rules.sourceQuote: Any individual with a bank account, aged between 18 and 70 years, who gives consent to auto-debit, is eligible.

rules.label: You have a bank account
rules.sourceQuote: A savings bank account is required to join the scheme and the premium is auto-debited from it.

jargon.meaning: Money paid if you are injured or die because of an accident.
A permanent injury that affects part of your body, like losing an eye or a hand.

documentGaps: The exact current premium amount is not stated here and should be checked with your bank.
